'''Nobot'''<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]''</ref> was a [[Color|silver]]-plated [[protocol droid]] with white [[sensor]]s.<ref name="TPM" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]].</ref> the [[droid]] was walking down a street on the edge of the [[Mos Espa]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] when [[Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] arrived in the [[city]] with [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks]]. The trio walked past Nobot, who had burns down the right side of its body that scarred its plating and right [[photoreceptor]] black.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nobot first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The character's name was first used in the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the [[2022]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga]]'',<ref name="LEGO" /> although it originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used by [[Shaun Flaherty]] (writing as "Jedi Flaherty") through [[StarWars.com]]'s [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]]"<ref name="Hyperspace">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/photoreceptor/2003/07/photoreceptor20030725.html|series=Photoreceptor|text=Protocol Potable}}</ref>

[[File:Nobot_lego.png|thumb|left|200px|Nobot as depicted in ''LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'']]
In ''The Skywalker Saga'', the events of which are non-canon, Nobot appears as the focus of the mission "Ghost Protocol," in which the player discovers the droid in a haunted hovel in Mos Espa, where he is seen running inside with a [[kyber brick]]. The droid vanishes after dashing into one of the hovel's rooms, then a key mysteriously drops from the ceiling, where it is used to open the crawlspace. When crawling inside as a Protocol Droid, Nobot appears again in front of the player with its legs missing and exits the crawlspace. It is rediscovered one last time with its head disconnected in a sealed room. Doing so completes the quest. If the player revisits the hovel, the door to the sealed room reopens by itself, revealing Nobot vanished.<ref name="LEGO" />

The description for the "Ghost Protocol" quest uses [[Gender|male]] pronouns for the droid and states that he wandered the streets of Mos Espa aimlessly, with no one knowing why he was there. It also says there are many rumors about the droid, with the only thing known for certain being that something was not right with Nobot.<ref name="LEGO" />
